title: queryContentReviewRecords
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Query content audit records. Currently, querying records with audit results of low (block) is supported.The number of query contents is limited to 500 (adjustable).
html:

GET/POST/content/mcn/content/queryReviewRecords
